title: Completeness
description: Every option card must state volume, timing, payment rail, port fit, and evidence before it may be arbitrated.

title: Security floor
description: No accepted plan may leave any refinery below the minimum days-of-cover floor.

title: Concentration cap
description: No single corridor or chokepoint may carry more than the capped share of total accepted volume.

title: Sanctions transparency
description: Every option must declare its payment rail and sanctions exposure explicitly; AMBER rails require a stated mitigation and RED rails are never silently laundered into a plan.

title: Stated uncertainty
description: Every quantitative claim in an option carries its provenance (R/E/S) and estimated values are never presented as confirmed.

title: Reversibility
description: Prefer options that can be unwound or redirected mid-voyage over irreversible commitments of similar value.

title: Traceability and human sovereignty
description: Every accept/reject decision is hash-chained in the audit log and a human can override any system verdict, with the override itself logged.
